sources.snippet: ReadyArt/Serenity-26B-A4B is a 26 billion parameter language model based on the GEMMA-4 architecture, fine-tuned with a 32768-token context length. It is a hybrid model combining the expressive depth of Melody and the immersive presence of Darkside, specifically designed for adult-oriented roleplay with mature themes and uncensored dialogue.
